title: No Evidence for an Item Limit in Change Detection
authors: Shaiyan Keshvari, Ronald van den Berg, Wei Ji Ma
caption_short: Orientation change detection trial sequence: a first display of oriented ellipses (100 ms), a 1000 ms delay, a second display (100 ms), and an unspeeded same/different ("change") response.

notes: Cropped panel (a) only of Figure 2 from page 4 at 440 dpi; panel label 'a' retained, panels (b) hit/false-alarm rates and (c) psychometric curves and the caption excluded, since only panel (a) shows the paradigm. The paper reports two change-detection experiments (orientation and color) in which change magnitude was drawn from a wide range including small changes; Figure 2a depicts the orientation version, and the color experiment used the same trial structure with colored disks. Set sizes were N = 2, 4, 6, 8.
